stem.text: Two balls float on the surface of the sea. The balls are separated by a distance of $1.30\,\text{m}$.
A wave travels on the surface of the sea so that the balls move vertically up and down.

stem.alt: Diagram marked NOT TO SCALE of a wave on the sea surface with two balls, labelled ball and direction of travel of wave; distances of 0.90 m and 1.30 m are marked between the balls.

stem.text: The distance between a crest and an adjacent trough of the wave is $0.90\,\text{m}$.
What is the phase difference between the two balls?
